notes.title: Tutorial modifications and bug fixes
notes.notes:
・Removed incomprehensible pictures from the tutorial.
・Fixed a fixed-point camera in the tutorial.
・Fixed a bug in checking name, age, and date of birth.

notes.title: Relaxation of curse conditions
notes.notes: Reduce the number of pictures used for curses

notes.title: Adjustment of difficulty level and addition of various surprise skills
notes.notes:
Adjustment of difficulty level and addition of various surprise skills
・Fixed that the “Show Vision” skill is checked for curse at the time of activation.
・Fixed the fixed-point camera in the replay to automatically track and switch between characters.
・Changed the flashing lights in the hunt.
・Added the following threat skills (threats only, not curses)
・Added a skill to destroy lights (destroy all the lights on the nearest switch)
・Added skill to turn off all lights (turns off all the lights in the house)
・Add the skill to close all doors (close all the doors of the house)
・Singing skill added (appears and sings)
・Add hand prints (put hand prints on the wall or door in front of you)

notes.title: Added description of curse
notes.notes: Added a brief explanation to the curses menu itself, as the tutorial's explanation of curses is confusing.

notes.title: Improved skill selection
notes.notes: Skill selection screen now reflects the result of the selection in the lower right corner of the screen

notes.title: Addressing a problem that sometimes prevents sound from sounding
notes.notes: Correspondence to the problem that sound does not sound after starting the stage in certain environments.

notes.notes: Change the switching order of fixed-point cameras

notes.title: Fixed-point camera implemented in replay.
notes.notes:
Set up a fixed-point camera in each house. Press "space" on the replay to switch from the investigator to the fixed-point camera.
To change to another fixed-point camera, scroll the mouse in the same way as the investigator.

notes.title: Added the ability to switch skills
notes.notes: Added the ability to switch skills by mouse scrolling

notes.title: Load Reduction Measures（Drawing settings added）
notes.notes:
As a load reduction measure, we have implemented a function that allows the following settings
・Resolution Scale
・View Distance
・Post Processing
・Shadow
・Texture
・Effect
・Foliage
・AntiAliasing

notes.notes: Adjustment of button being off-screen when resizing the screen

notes.title: process mitigation measures
notes.notes: Reduce background objects that are barely visible on the screen

notes.title: Reduce processing load & adjust some functions
notes.notes:
Reduced processing load
・Changed the way investigators are drawn.
・Removed unnecessary objects on the map

Adjustment of functions
・Adjusted the randomness of the investigator's personality, which sometimes resulted in an extremely high probability of placing salt.
・Shortened the reload time of some threat skills by 10 seconds.

notes.title: Corrected a change error.
notes.notes: Fixed a process that was not executed due to a change in processing order.

notes.title: Improved timing of curse checks
notes.notes:
When "Show and Surprise" was applied to an investigator, there was a 2-second waiting period before the check was placed in the Curse Preparation, which could be misinterpreted as unchecked when the menu was activated.
Therefore, the processing order was changed and the check is now placed at the moment the investigator is hit.

notes.title: Added functionality to replay
notes.notes:
Added the ability to change the camera viewpoint during replay to behind the character. (To prevent screen-sickness)
・Left click：Fix camera behind the character (third-person view)
・Right-click：Camera is fixed behind the character (third-person view).

Additional workaround for problem with viewpoint movement sometimes not working at the start of the game.
